message:
The other day, I was caught in a surprise thunderstorm while out with my grandkids. There we were, huddled under a picnic table, watching the rain take on a life of its own. My grandson, with his eyes wide, asked if we were going to float away. I couldn’t help but chuckle at how unprepared we were—no rain gear, no snacks, not even a good book to pass the time! 

It reminded me that sometimes, a little spontaneity is part of the fun, but it’s nice to have a plan too. I’ve started keeping a small emergency kit in the trunk of my car, just in case we find ourselves in a pickle again. What’s your favorite tip for being ready for a surprise storm? ☔
